##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 13 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by an approaching frontal zone.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming northwest 3 to 5 tomorrow morning, but variable 3 or less in the west of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches until later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, but variable 3 or less in the west of the area at first, veering north or northwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
